paragraphs.text: The Darkling Plains were flatlands in Golthonor on the continent of Corondor on Dominaria .

The Darkling Plains are home to the nomad war tribes of Golthonor . From this endless scrub great armies can be raised and chaos unleashed. A subregion, the Plains of Coloni were the plains nearest to the Great Salt Marshes . Altair of Coloni was from this area.
The Darkling Plains were used as a battleground for the warlord Warlord Mandek Ironfist .
